activity_invalid.name: activity_invalid
activity_invalid.long_description: The current activity is invalid and cannot be processed further.

activity_convert.name: convert
activity_convert.long_description: The current media is in the process of being converted from one format to another.

activity_failed.name: failed
activity_failed.long_description: The current media process has encountered an error and has failed to complete successfully.

activity_failed_codec.name: failed_codec

activity_failed_container.name: failed_container
activity_failed_container.long_description: The media process has failed due to an invalid or unsupported container format.

activity_failed_corrupt.name: failed_corrupt
activity_failed_corrupt.long_description: The media process failed because the input file is corrupt and unreadable.

activity_failed_file.name: failed_file

activity_failed_file_missing.name: failed_file_missing

activity_failed_file_permissions.name: failed_file_permissions

activity_failed_file_not_recognized.name: failed_file_not_recognized
activity_failed_file_not_recognized.long_description: The media process failed because the input file format is not recognized.

activity_failed_hardware.name: failed_hardware
activity_failed_hardware.long_description: The media process failed due to a hardware-related error or malfunction.

activity_failed_invalid_audio_channels.name: failed_invalid_audio_channels

activity_failed_invalid_duration_ss.name: failed_invalid_duration_ss

activity_failed_invalid_duration_to.name: failed_invalid_duration_to

activity_finished.name: finished

activity_statistics.name: statistics

activity_waiting_convert.name: waiting_convert

activity_waiting_statistics.name: waiting_statistics
activity_waiting_statistics.long_description: The media process is waiting for statistical data or results.

activity_waiting_validate.name: waiting_validate

activity_validate.name: validate
